snippet.title: Bat Boy - Kickstarter Trailer (EN)
snippet.description:
Bat Boy, A Sentai Sports Hero 8-Bit Action Adventure
is coming to Kickstarter! (Link Below)
Come and get involved!

Interdimensional mage Lord Vicious has brainwashed Bat Boy’s fellow teammates in order to participate in the Trials of Darkness, a heinously brutal series of athletic events! It’s up to Bat Boy to team up with one-time villain and mouthy crow Garou, traversing all manner of hostile regions, to free the minds of his sports-hero teammates before they fall victim to the Trials.

========================
Support us on Kickstarter
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/xplusgames/bat-boy

Follow us on Twitter for more upcoming information
X PLUS Games: https://twitter.com/XPlusGames
Sonzai Games: https://twitter.com/SonzaiGames

Got some feedback regarding the game? Come talk to us on Discord
http://discord.gg/XABkugKABq
